**Done. Repeats within 5 minutes now drop.**

The router remembers the last send time per `key`. A same-key notification less than 5 minutes later returns nothing. Only real sends update the clock, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window.

The replay drops 99 of 900. `verify.js` passes too.

One call I made: exactly 5 minutes later counts as a new send, not a repeat.
